steps.description:
The whole doctype: a catalogue of conditions — Malaria, Upper Respiratory Tract Infection, Backache — shared by the monthly health report and the risk rows on a test result.

You rarely add one by hand: a condition COVA reports that is not on the list yet is created for you. Worth a look now and then, because two near-identical spellings arriving from the clinic each become their own case and split the counts on the dashboard.
steps.label: Case
steps.title: 1. The name of the condition — required

steps.description:
A Medical Case is one condition in your catalogue. It is a short list you curate once.

Where you go next: these names become the rows of the Health Monthly Report, and the labels down the side of Condition by Risk Grade on the dashboard. Keep the wording steady — a condition spelled two ways counts as two conditions and splits its own trend.

Fill the fields marked required and press Save (Ctrl+S). The onboarding step ticks itself off as soon as the record exists.
